title: Machine Politics
text: End the game holding three or more constituencies. The machine doesn't ask for votes — it collects them.

title: The Corridor
text: End the game holding two adjacent constituencies. Control the road and you control what travels on it.

title: The Middle Path
text: End the game holding the Center. Whoever sits in the capital writes the history.

title: War Chest
text: End the game strictly richer than every rival. Campaigns end; accounts don't.

title: Clean Hands
text: Never take an IOU all game. Owe nobody, and nobody owns you.

title: The Deep State
text: Play three or more conspiracies over the game. Elections are decided long before the counting.

title: The Trapper
text: Gerrymander rivals' voters into Volatile Areas twice. Let them explain the headlines.

title: The Big Prize
text: End the game holding the South-East, the largest constituency on the map.

title: Everywhere at Once
text: End the game with voters in six or more constituencies. A face on every wall.

title: Untouchable
text: End the game holding a constituency, having never lost a majority all game. They never laid a finger on you.
